svg.aria-label: The staging of the Research Summary Presentations: Day 1, research alone and prepare a summary of your research; Day 2, share summaries in your group, then prepare the group talk; Day 4, presentations 1 and 2; Day 5 (today), presentations 3, 4 and 5. Topic: exploring our digital carbon footprint. Rhetorical function: cause and effect.
